name: novaforge
description: Build Powerful CLIs. Ship Better Tools.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@devnovaa-id/novaforge-core && npm run build --workspace=@devnovaa-id/novaforge-testing && npm run build --workspace=@devnovaa-id/novaforge-prompt && npm run build --workspace=@devnovaa-id/novaforge-terminal-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:core && npm run build --workspace=@devnovaa-id/novaforge-core && npm run typecheck:testing && npm run typecheck:prompt && npm run typecheck:terminal-ui
scripts.pack:check: npm run build && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@devnovaa-id/novaforge-core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@devnovaa-id/novaforge-testing && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@devnovaa-id/novaforge-prompt && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@devnovaa-id/novaforge-terminal-ui
